sources.description: English vanilla localization of Europa Universalis V (commands observed in use; meanings inferred from name and usage)

notes.text: Bracketed [...] data functions are replaced at runtime. Keep them exactly, including saved-scope calls such as [SCOPE.sCountry('name').GetName] and any |modifiers.

Formatting uses #tag text#! (for example #P, #N, #E, #bold, #italic); a space after the tag key is required but not shown, and no space goes before #!. Icons are @icon_key!; $key$ inserts another localization key.
[concept_name|e] is a game concept link. Dropping one loses the tooltip even if the plain word is translated.

zh-CN.text: 中文本地化里代词命令输出他/她；中文没有主格宾格之分，任何代词命令都可作主语或宾语。
因中文习惯省略重复的代词命令是合理的，前提是指代仍然清楚；不要把代词命令写死成“他”或“她”。没有必要时，应尽量保持与原文相同的命令引用。

suffixes.WithNoTooltip: same value as plain text without tooltip

scopes.SCOPE: saved-scope accessor, used as SCOPE.sCountry('name'), SCOPE.sCharacter('name') and similar

GetNameWithFlag.meaning: country name as a tooltipped string with flag

GetAdjective.meaning: country adjective as a tooltipped string

GetLaw.meaning: the named law as an object for further functions

ScriptValue.meaning: calculated value of the named script value

GetLocalVariable.meaning: script variable accessor; usually followed by .GetValue

GetValue.meaning: numeric value of the preceding object

GetHerHis.meaning: pronoun her or his by gender

sCountry.meaning: saved-scope accessor for a country saved with save_scope_as

sCharacter.meaning: saved-scope accessor for a character saved with save_scope_as

GetSheHe.meaning: pronoun she or he by gender

GetHeShe.meaning: pronoun he or she by gender

GetHerHim.meaning: pronoun her or him by gender

GetHimHer.meaning: pronoun him or her by gender

GetHisHer.meaning: pronoun his or her by gender

GetHerselfHimself.meaning: reflexive pronoun herself or himself by gender

GetEstateName.meaning: name of an estate in this government

GetFlavorRank.meaning: the country's flavoured rank word (for example kingdom, empire, republic)

ShowNamedValue.meaning: prints a named game value; keep the key and |format unchanged

ShowModifier.meaning: prints a modifier and its value

Link.meaning: clickable link to a game panel: Link('target','parameters','display text'); translate only the display text argument

patterns.meaning: the {1} of the given {0} object, as tooltipped text; the quoted argument is a script key, not translatable text
